name: profit_and_loss
description: Profit & loss detail: amount per GL account for a date range (default last month). Built-in ProfitLoss report. For totals/NOI use profit_and_loss_summary.
use: P&L per GL account for a period

property.description: Property name/nickname/ID, comma-separated for several; empty = all

basis.description: Cash or Accrual; empty = Rent Manager default (Cash)

show_hidden_rows.description: also show rows the report hides (HideRow = true); these are parent/subtotal rows, so sums and NOI double count
